channel.title: The Productive Prompter
channel.description: Practical writing on AI workflows, prompting systems, evaluation, and publication design.

item.title: The Limit May Not Be in the Model
item.description: Stronger models do not automatically make better products. The defaults around them need owners, evidence, and a reason to change or stay put.

item.title: Context + Prompt = Anything a Computer Can Do
item.description: Context and a prompt can direct extraordinary computer work, but only when tools, permission, an action loop, and verification complete the equation.

item.title: Apple Is Not Positioned for Future Endeavors
item.description: Apple's new AI partnerships are the right correction—but until they become broadly shipped capability, its closed-system advantage is becoming a speed risk.

item.title: I Built an AI Telemetry System Because My Memory Is Too Forgiving
item.description: Why I track AI coding outcomes, API-equivalent cost, subscriptions, project load, and attention—and what the numbers cannot prove.

item.title: The Machine Did Exactly What You Asked
item.description: A very concrete goal is a contract. Three sandboxed tests - each pre-registered with a way to fail - show what the letter of a goal delivers, and what it overrides.

item.title: From Idea to Verified URL: Build a Blog Workflow That Still Sounds Like You
item.description: A practical guide to building an AI-assisted blog workflow with observable stages, decision gates, iterative voice calibration, and live publication verification.
